snippet.title: We Drained Cook Strait. Here's What Was Hidden at the Bottom.
snippet.description:
Pull the water out of Cook Strait and you'd find a rock that almost touches the surface, wrecks along its edges and hills of gravel the tide keeps reshaping. Go deeper and New Zealand's two main islands join up, and then the floor falls into a canyon.

In this documentary:
- Why the tide reaches the Pacific end about 5 hours before the Tasman end
- The Wahine (734 aboard, 53 lost) and the 155 m Mikhail Lermontov, lying in about 30 m of water
- Pelorus Jack, the Risso's dolphin protected by his own Order in Council
- The power cables: 40 km of seabed, opened in 1965, inside a 7 km protection zone
- The ice-age land bridge, breached about 15,000 years ago
- The 1855 magnitude 8.2 quake, Haowhenua, and a canyon floor about 3,000 m deep

CHAPTERS

2:00 The drain begins: Fisherman's Rock

10:59 The two islands are joined

15:15 The faults
15:49 23 January 1855
16:46 c. 1460: Haowhenua
17:56 The Cook Strait Canyon
20:39 Letting the water back in
21:20 The humpback survey
22:46 Ngāti Kuia tradition

snippet.title: POV: You make up symptoms to visit the nurse, your mom sees the game
snippet.description:
The endless drone of my math teacher’s voice blurred into a monotonous hum, and I stared blankly at the numbers scrawled across the whiteboard, my fingers tapping restlessly against my desk. It was only mid-morning, but the school day already felt endless. The final period before lunch was math, my least favorite subject, and a grueling quiz waited for us at the end of class. I hadn’t studied a single page the night before, dreading the complex equations and tricky word problems that would surely stump me. As I slouched in my seat, a lazy, reckless idea popped into my head: I could fake being sick to skip class and hide away in the school nurse’s office.
I lifted a hand to my forehead, forcing my eyelids to droop and my shoulders to slump forward dramatically. I squeezed my eyes shut every few seconds, feigning dizziness and fatigue, making sure my body language screamed unwell. I’d pulled this trick a handful of times before, and it never failed to work. The teacher noticed my odd behavior within minutes, pausing his lecture to glance in my direction with a concerned frown. “Are you feeling alright?” he asked, his tone softening with worry.
I shook my head weakly, letting out a quiet, breathless sigh. “I have a terrible headache and a stomachache,” I mumbled, my voice quiet and hoarse as I forced a shaky tone. “I feel really dizzy and nauseous. I don’t think I can stay in class.” I added a small cough for extra effect, pressing my palm firmly to my abdomen to sell the fake discomfort.
The teacher didn’t hesitate to believe me. He handed me a nurse’s pass with a sympathetic smile, telling me to rest well and not worry about the quiz for the day. I thanked him weakly, dragging my feet as I walked out of the classroom, careful to keep my act up until the door clicked shut behind me. The second I turned the corner and was out of sight, my slouched posture straightened instantly. The fake exhaustion melted away, replaced by giddy relief and quiet excitement.
The nurse’s office was quiet and empty when I arrived. The school nurse, a kind and laid-back woman, barely glanced up from her desk before waving me over. I repeated my fake symptoms, exaggerating the headache and stomach pain, and she sighed gently, assuming I just needed a quiet place to rest. She let me lie down on one of the soft cots in the back room, handing me a cold water bottle and telling me I could rest there until the end of the period. Once she returned to her desk and left me alone, I pulled out my phone from my pocket, my heart racing with excitement.
I’d been waiting all week to grind through the new update of my favorite mobile game, and school rules strictly banned phone use during class time. This fake sick day was the perfect chance to play without interruption or punishment. I propped myself up on the cot, pulled the thin curtain closed around my bed for privacy, and launched the game immediately. The stress of the math quiz and the tedious schoolwork vanished completely as I immersed myself in the vibrant virtual world. I tapped rapidly at the screen, completing quests, battling opponents, and laughing quietly at the in-game chats, completely oblivious to my surroundings.
I was so focused on winning a tough level that I didn’t hear the faint sound of the office door opening. I didn’t notice the quiet footsteps walking toward the resting cots or the soft rustle of the curtain being pulled aside. It was only when a familiar, icy-calm voice spoke my name that I froze mid-tap, my thumb hovering inches above the phone screen.
My blood ran cold. I slowly lifted my head and turned around, my heart dropping straight to my stomach. My mom was standing right behind me, her arms crossed tightly over her chest, her expression completely unreadable. I later learned she’d received a routine automated school email notifying her I’d checked into the nurse’s office for illness. Worried about my health, she’d rushed over from work to pick me up early, ready to take me home and care for me. Instead of finding a sick, exhausted child, she’d found me fully awake, energized, and glued to my phone, fully immersed in a video game.
The room went dead silent. The bright game music still playing from my phone sounded embarrassingly loud and out of place in the quiet office. I fumbled frantically to turn off the game, my hands shaking uncontrollably with panic and guilt. All the fake symptoms I’d put on earlier vanished in an instant; there was no headache, no stomachache, no dizziness—only pure, humiliating shame.
The nurse peeked over from her desk, clearly confused by the sudden tension, and I wanted to bury my face in the cot and disappear entirely. My mom didn’t yell or scold me right away. She simply stared at me with a disappointed, weary look that stung far worse than any angry words. There was no anger in her eyes, just quiet sadness that I’d lied to skip class and wasted everyone’s time with a silly, selfish trick.

snippet.title: BRAZIL VÀ SERBIA DỌN ĐƯỜNG, U17 VIỆT NAM THĂNG TIẾN SÁT TỚI TẤM VÉ LỊCH SỬ TẠI WORLD CUP
snippet.description:
Brazil và Serbia dọn đường, U17 Việt Nam thăng tiến sát tới tấm vé lịch sử tại World Cup. Tin vui vừa đến với U17 Việt Nam tại U17 World Cup 2026. Dù chưa bước vào trận chung kết gặp Mali, nhưng thầy trò huấn luyện viên Cristiano Roland đã liên tiếp nhận được những món quà từ trên trời rơi xuống. Cụ thể, các đối thủ cạnh tranh trực tiếp đều đã ngã ngựa khi U17 Tanzania thất thủ 0-1 trước U17 Brazil, còn U17 Nhật Bản cũng ôm hận với tỷ số tương tự trước U17 Serbia. Nhờ 2 kết quả cực kỳ thuận lợi này, U17 Việt Nam đã bứt phá ngoạn mục, leo 1 mạch lên vị trí thứ 7 trên tổng số 12 đội bóng xếp hạng 3. Điều này đồng nghĩa với việc chúng ta đang chễm chệ trong nhóm 8 đội có thành tích tốt nhất để đoạt vé vớt lọt vào vòng 32 đội. Tuy nhiên, cờ đã đến tay nhưng ta vẫn phải tự mình phất. Phía trước vẫn là thử thách cực đại mang tên U17 Mali. Đây là lúc những Nguyễn Lực, Sỹ Bách hay Đại Nhân phải dồn toàn bộ sức mạnh để biến thiên thời, địa lợi thành chiến tích lịch sử cho bóng đá nước nhà. Theo anh em, với đà hưng phấn này, U17 Việt Nam có tạo ra địa chấn trước Mali không.

snippet.title: 💄✨ 3 Genius Makeup Hacks & Easy Party Makeup Ideas! 💖 #shorts #makeuphacks #beautytips
snippet.description:
Want to achieve a flawless makeup look using simple and clever beauty tricks? Try these three amazing makeup hacks using everyday items like scissors, cotton buds, and spoons. These easy techniques will help you create a sharp jawline, fix accidental mascara smudges, and achieve beautiful party eye makeup without any complicated steps! ❤️

1. 💗 Sharp Jawline Makeup Hack
   Create a beautifully defined and sculpted jawline using a simple makeup placement technique! First, hold a pair of scissors against your cheek as a positioning guide. Apply contour in the upper circular area and concealer in the lower area. Carefully remove the scissors, then blend both products smoothly with a makeup brush to create a natural-looking definition. Your gorgeous sharp jawline makeup look is ready!

2. 👁️ Easy Mascara Smudge Removal Hack
   Accidentally got mascara under your eyes after completing your makeup? Try this simple cleanup trick! Take a clean cotton bud and apply a small amount of concealer to its tip. Gently roll it over the mascara smudge to lift the unwanted mark without disturbing the surrounding makeup. Now use a small makeup brush to blend the area smoothly. Your under-eye makeup looks clean and fresh again!

3. ✨ Pink & Shimmer Party Eye Makeup
   Create a gorgeous party eye makeup look using a simple spoon! First, gently place a spoon over your eyelid to use its curved edge as a guide for defining the crease and creating a winged eyeliner shape. Carefully remove the spoon and complete the eyeliner. Now apply beautiful pink eyeshadow followed by shimmering eyeshadow, and blend the colours smoothly for a stunning finish. Your glamorous pink and shimmer party eye makeup is ready!
